title.en: southbank winter market under hungerford bridge.
title.de: southbank winter market unter der hungerford bridge.
title.tr: hungerford bridge altında southbank winter market.

line.en: chalets and bars along the queen's walk, with stalls open until ten at night. a thursday evening, before the weekend crowds; walk the river afterwards.
line.de: hütten und bars am queen's walk, die stände sind bis 22 uhr offen. ein donnerstagabend, vor dem wochenendgedränge; danach am fluss entlang gehen.
line.tr: queen's walk boyunca kulübeler ve barlar; standlar gece 22'ye kadar açık. hafta sonu kalabalığından önce bir perşembe akşamı; sonra nehir boyunca yürü.

sparks.why: Southbank Centre Winter Market listed for 2 Nov 2026 to 3 Jan 2027 by South Bank London, stall hours 11:00 to 22:00 per Time Out and EcoFlow; not checked on the official site, and Visit London still shows the dates as expected.
